name: Alarms vs Trips
title: Alarms vs Trips
description: Alarms warn operators (act now); trips act automatically (too late for humans). Alarms need operator response; trips need correct setpoints. Confusing them kills.
how_it_works: Set alarms with time to respond before the trip, set trips to act before damage, and never use alarms where trips are needed. Test both.
key_points: Trips where humans can't act in time.
requirements: Defined normal operating envelope; alarm and trip setpoints; shutdown sequences.
citations: ISA-18.2 management of alarm systems.
